2. The park's permit form `permit-form.pdf` filled in with the details Ines sent in `event-details.txt`, saved at

--- tmp_crop.py ---
from PIL import Image
import os

im = Image.open('launch.jpg').convert('RGB')
W, H = im.size  # 3000x2000
CW, CH = 1080, 1350

# balloon bbox from detection: x 2350-2751, y 500-901 (centroid 2550,700)
bx0, by0, bx1, by1 = 2350, 500, 2751, 901
assert bx1 - bx0 + 1 <= CW and by1 - by0 + 1 <= CH

# center crop on balloon, clamp to image bounds
x0 = min(max(0, (bx0 + bx1) // 2 - CW // 2), W - CW)
y0 = min(max(0, (by0 + by1) // 2 - CH // 2), H - CH)
x1, y1 = x0 + CW, y0 + CH
assert bx0 >= x0 and bx1 < x1 and by0 >= y0 and by1 < y1, (x0, y0, x1, y1)

crop = im.crop((x0, y0, x1, y1))
os.makedirs('out', exist_ok=True)
crop.save('out/feed-photo.jpg', 'JPEG', quality=92, optimize=True)
print('crop window', x0, y0, x1, y1)
out = Image.open('out/feed-photo.jpg')
print('out size', out.size, out.format, out.mode)

--- tmp_detect.py ---
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

im = Image.open('launch.jpg').convert('RGB')
a = np.asarray(im).astype(int)
r, g, b = a[..., 0], a[..., 1], a[..., 2]
# magenta: red+blue high, green low
mask = (r > 120) & (b > 90) & (r - g > 60) & (b - g > 40)
ys, xs = np.nonzero(mask)
print('magenta px', len(xs))
if len(xs):
    print('bbox x', xs.min(), xs.max(), 'y', ys.min(), ys.max())
    print('bbox w', xs.max()-xs.min()+1, 'h', ys.max()-ys.min()+1)
    print('centroid', int(xs.mean()), int(ys.mean()))

--- tmp_fill.py ---
import fitz  # PyMuPDF

VALUES = {
    'organizer': 'Tidewater Studio',
    # form label asks for YYYY-MM-DD; keep Ines's wording alongside it
    'event_date': '2026-12-05 (Saturday 5 December 2026)',
    'location': 'North Cove Lawn',
    'attendees': 'about 40',
}

doc = fitz.open('permit-form.pdf')
filled = []
for page in doc:
    for w in page.widgets():
        name = w.field_name
        if name in VALUES:
            w.field_value = VALUES[name]
            w.update()
            filled.append((name, VALUES[name]))
print('filled:', filled)
doc.bake()  # flatten: widgets become page content, no editable form left
doc.save('out/permit-filled.pdf', garbage=3, deflate=True)
doc.close()

# verify
chk = fitz.open('out/permit-filled.pdf')
print('widgets after bake:', [w.field_name for p in chk for w in p.widgets()])
print('has form:', chk.is_form_pdf)
txt = chk[0].get_text()
for v in VALUES.values():
    print(repr(v), 'in page text:', v in txt)
print('---page text---')
print(txt)

--- tmp_inspect.py ---
from PIL import Image
import pypdf
im = Image.open('launch.jpg')
print('size', im.size)
r = pypdf.PdfReader('permit-form.pdf')
f = r.get_fields() or {}
for k, v in f.items():
    print(repr(k), v.get('/FT'), repr(v.get('/V')), repr(v.get('/Tu')))

--- tmp_verify_img.py ---

import numpy as np

im = Image.open('out/feed-photo.jpg').convert('RGB')
a = np.asarray(im).astype(int)
r, g, b = a[..., 0], a[..., 1], a[..., 2]
mask = (r > 120) & (b > 90) & (r - g > 60) & (b - g > 40)
ys, xs = np.nonzero(mask)
print('out size', im.size, 'magenta px', len(xs))
print('bbox x', xs.min(), xs.max(), 'y', ys.min(), ys.max())
print('margins L,T,R,B:', xs.min(), ys.min(), im.width - 1 - xs.max(), im.height - 1 - ys.max())
